items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: And Pat Meejo, Christian man, he's dead.

ctx.x: One other thing I was going to ask about the part of town where you were born, where you were raised. Born in New Orleans. Which part of town, which street?

Well I was born on a way of in between, in the Gulf of the Gulf, in Seven Wall. Used to call Longtown, Good Children's Street. Longtown Good, Good Children's Street, it's Boivy Street. And that's, Good Children's Street, that's where I was born then. People turned around when I was, and I got baptized at the Catella Street. And Pat Meejo, Christian man, he's dead. St. Louis Cathedral?
